title: A New Package for Numerical Algorithms

Recently, I was inspired by `torch.distributions` and `torch.special` packages. I am planning to work on creating a new package named `torch.numericalalgorithms` in late October 2025 to support a wide range of well-known numerical algorithm techniques.
